Use-case & requirements (from infra + CTO quotes):
- Workload: tight-feedback loops for UI personalization, 2–3 round-trip messages in chat flows, and real-time reranking for feed items.
- Latency SLO: target P95 <= 100ms for single-turn re-rank calls; 50ms ideal for microcalls (prefix-cached).
- Throughput: sustained 300 rps with spikes to 950 rps (holiday/flash sales).
- Cost: aggressive — want options to trade accuracy for 30–50% token-cost reduction.
- Models: experimenting with open LLM family (Trillium-7B and Trillium-13B forks). Need guidance on compatible quantization profiles (4-bit/INT8) and recommended kernel sets per GPU type.
- Routing: prefer region-aware routing + cheaper fallback model when Dedicated capacity is taxed.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-model latency histograms, and request traces tied to user-id for debugging.
- Security: SSO + SAML required, audit logging with 365d retention, KMS integration for customer keys.

POC focus areas asked of Redwood (explicit asks):
1) Provide a perf matrix: quantized vs fp16 vs int8 p95 and throughput across NVIDIA A10G and A4000. Include batching impact (batch sizes 1, 4, 8) and KV/cache warm vs cold.
2) Demonstrate prefix/KV caching — show p95 improvements for common prefixes (chat context reuse).
3) Show batching policy where latency SLO maintained but tail improved; need suggested autoscale/burst policy for Dedicated.
4) Cost model: expected token and infra unit cost per 1M inference tokens at different quantization and batching configs.
5) Provide step-by-step runbook for switching routing to a smaller fallback model during overload, including compatibility guarantees.

- Early quantized trial (third-party script) drops cost ~35% but increased p95 by ~20ms and produced occasional coherence regressions.
- Batching analysis shows 8x batch improves throughput but single-request median suffers; need continuous-batching recommendation.
